name: Adobe
fiscalYearEnd: Friday nearest November 30 (FY2025 ended 2025-11-28; Q3 FY2026 ended 2026-08-28)
description: Adobe sells subscription software for creating and managing content: Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Firefly AI image and video tools, Express) and Document Cloud (Acrobat and PDF), plus Experience Cloud, enterprise marketing and analytics software sold to companies. 97% of revenue is subscription. From the first quarter of FY2026 Adobe reports one segment instead of three (Digital Media, Digital Experience, Publishing and Advertising) and instead reports revenue by customer group. Cash goes to buybacks, not dividends; shares outstanding fell from 413M to 391M in a year. CEO Shantanu Narayen hands over to Anil Chakravarthy on December 1, 2026.

businessLines.how: Monthly and annual per-user subscriptions to creative and PDF tools, sold to individuals, teams and enterprises; AI features are sold as credits and as higher plan tiers.
